title: Time Table - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Time Table - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: Lady Irwin College in Delhi offers a B.Sc. Full-Time (Honours) 1‑Year program starting in August 2025. The college is part of the University of Delhi and holds an A+ NAAC accreditation with a NIRF ranking of 31. Contact information includes a phone number (014836) and an admission enquiry window from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm. The website provides quick links for students, details on college timing, and a visitor section, all presented under a 2026 copyright notice and powered by WhiteCode.
